name: Singita Sasakwa Lodge
positioning: Safari lodge built in the style of an Edwardian manor house on Sasakwa Hill, inside the 350,000-acre Singita Grumeti Reserve in the Serengeti
best_for: Safari travelers who want old-world manor-house style with panoramic views over the Serengeti plains
Guests who want a private cottage with a fireplace, living room and veranda

facts.text: Sasakwa is built in the style of a stately Edwardian manor house.
From Sasakwa Hill, the lodge has panoramic views of the Serengeti plains.
The lodge features a grand entrance, wraparound verandas, silver candelabras and antiques.
The decor includes local artefacts and tribal cushions.
The cottages have en-suite bathrooms, dressing areas, fireplaces, living rooms and French doors opening onto verandas.
The cottages feature polished parquet floors and vintage collectables.
The cottages provide guests with complete privacy.
Sasakwa is in the 350,000-acre Singita Grumeti Reserve in the Serengeti.
Singita Grumeti is adjacent to the Serengeti National Park in Tanzania.
Leisure activities include bush walks, wellness treatments and tennis.
The lodge has a swimming pool and a fitness centre, and offers yoga.
The Serengeti plains around the reserve see the annual wildebeest migration.

highlights.text: Sasakwa is built in the style of a stately Edwardian manor house, with a grand entrance, wraparound verandas, silver candelabras and antiques.
From Sasakwa Hill, the lodge has panoramic views of the Serengeti plains.
The cottages have fireplaces, living rooms, dressing areas, polished parquet floors and French doors opening onto verandas.
Leisure activities include bush walks, wellness treatments and tennis, and guests can take a hot air balloon safari.

considerations.text: The style is old-world, in the manner of an Edwardian manor house, with antiques, silver candelabras and vintage collectables.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires chartered flights and extensive travel planning.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the lodge's exclusive positioning.
